scenario.intent: Generate a beginner wall-mounted mug peg rail using a single back board, evenly spaced pegs or hooks, wall mounting holes, and clear mark-drill-install instructions.
builder_goals: use one common 1x4 board
space six mug hooks evenly with safe edge clearance
include wall mounting holes and pilot hole guidance
produce a simple staged build sequence

scenario.intent: Generate a wall-mounted entry organizer with a back panel, shallow mail cubby, lower row of key hooks, and wall mounting holes.
builder_goals: use existing pocket, panel, hook, spacing, and wall-mount components if available
avoid requesting a duplicate mail pocket component if a shallow wall pocket already exists
include staged build steps that show pocket assembly before hook installation

scenario.intent: Generate a small outdoor planter box with slatted sides, a bottom panel, drainage holes, and beginner-friendly build guidance.
builder_goals: use cedar or outdoor-friendly stock
show bottom panel as a flat panel, not a long narrow rail
include drainage hole location guidance and edge clearance
sequence the side slats and end panels logically

scenario.intent: Generate a compact desktop bookshelf with side panels, top and bottom shelves, two adjustable dividers, and optional back rail for racking resistance.
builder_goals: use plywood or 1x boards
validate divider spacing and clear book openings
show box assembly before dividers are installed
include square-check guidance before fastening the back rail

scenario.intent: Generate a rolling garage workbench base that stores two 27-gallon totes on runner rails and uses casters under a rectangular frame.
builder_goals: use reusable rectangular frame bay, tote runner, caster plate, spacing, and overlap validation components if available
include clear tote lip clearance assumptions
show front/back frame assembly before runner installation
include caster plate layout and reinforcement guidance

scenario.intent: Generate a folding sawhorse concept with paired angled legs, top beam, hinge hardware, spreader restraint, and conservative safety warnings.
builder_goals: avoid claiming load capacity without deterministic structural validation
include hinge and spreader hardware layout
validate leg clearances and fastener edge distance
request missing folding-mechanism support if current components cannot represent it safely

scenario.intent: Generate a fold-flat two-step stool concept with hinged side frames, two treads, locking spreader arms, and conservative warnings for human structural review.
builder_goals: treat this as a dimensional concept only unless deterministic load validation exists
check for overlapping parts and unsafe cantilevered treads
sequence hinge layout, tread installation, and spreader installation clearly
request missing components or validators if folding geometry cannot be represented
